intelligence.description: ElevenLabs builds AI voice, audio, dubbing, and conversational-agent tools for creators, developers, and enterprises.
company: ElevenLabs builds AI voice and audio products, including speech generation, dubbing, and tools for conversational agents.
The company raised $500 million in a Series D at an $11 billion valuation in February 2026.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Voice is becoming a core interface for AI agents and customer operations. ElevenLabs is a leading private-company signal for how much value can accrue to the audio and agent layer rather than the underlying foundation models alone.

takeaways: The Series D set a disclosed $11B valuation.
ElevenLabs reported more than $330M in ARR at the end of 2025 and later announced it had crossed $500M ARR.
Enterprise retention and competition from model providers remain key watch items.
